item.title: Not So Closed Minded, Part 52
item.description: Read Not So Closed Minded, Part 52 We have closed, and my manager is in the process of locking the doors when a woman comes rushing up to the door. Customer: *Almost crying.* "Please! My car broke down and I just need a car battery!" Manager: "Fine, as long as you're just getting a car battery." Read Not So Closed Minded, Part 52

item.title: Checkout Calling, Part 3
item.description: Read Checkout Calling, Part 3 My checkout customer is, like so many others, glued to their phone when they should be focusing on, y'know… checking out. So, I go to my usual strategy when this happens (as long as there isn't a long line), and I just stand there and stare at them in silence until they realize I'm not scanning anything or touching the register. Read Checkout Calling, Part 3

item.title: It’s McDouble Or McNothing
item.description: Read It’s McDouble Or McNothing Me: "Alright, let me just have a regular McDouble then." Employee: "You don't want anything on it?" Me: "Nope! Thank you!" Read It’s McDouble Or McNothing

item.title: How To Extinguish A Friendship
item.description: Read How To Extinguish A Friendship I see a guy smoking while pumping. I get on the PA and say: Me: "Sir! You gotta extinguish the butt while pumping!" He responded by flicking his lighter and holding it up to the hose. Read How To Extinguish A Friendship

item.title: That’s Some Dollar Store Diplomacy
item.description: Read That’s Some Dollar Store Diplomacy I'm visiting the Independence Palace (Old US Embassy) in Ho Chi Min (Saigon). A visitor is at the ticketing desk a few places ahead of me, speaking in loud, aggravated English. Visitor: "What do you mean I can't use my dollars! This is the original American Embassy!" Read That’s Some Dollar Store Diplomacy
